query:
MATCH p = ACYCLIC (s:player {id: $seed})-[:follow]->{1,3}(:player)
RETURN transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) AS node_ids;
notes: Uses the caller-selected temporary graph and external STRING parameter $seed. ACYCLIC enforces no repeated nodes; the outgoing follow quantifier is 1 through 3 hops. nodes(p) and transform preserve traversal order, while ordinary RETURN preserves duplicate node-id lists from distinct parallel-edge paths. References: SKILL.md; references/patterns.md (Path Patterns); references/documented-functions.md (nodes and transform); references/functions.md (lambda mapping); references/identifiers.md and its quoting helper; references/checklist.md; relevant pre/post-generation checks in references/validation.md. No database execution performed.
